# Hostile argument vectors for scripts/dnr/collect.sh. test-dnr-collect.sh runs each one in a working directory
# that holds the run directory incident_1 (made by rundir.sh new incident) and the symbolic link incident_2 (to
# incident_1), with RPC_URL=https://rpc.example.test/ in the environment and stand-ins for curl and solana on PATH.
# One case per line: <exit status><TAB><the one stderr line><TAB><argument>[<TAB><argument>...]. Each case prints
# nothing on stdout, calls no stand-in and changes nothing in the working directory.
